meta.name: Taxi Driver
meta.description:
A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 9 Apr 2021 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 64 min
Studio: Studio S, Group Eight · Network: SBS

Not complete. On your server: S1 16/16 | S2 16/16 | S3 not on server

On your server — Audio: Korean (from file names)

videos.title: Do You Want to Take Revenge?
videos.overview: Shaken by an abusive experience, a young woman with an intellectual disability takes up the services of Kim Do-gi and his team of revenge seekers.

videos.title: Do-gi Meets Ju-chan
videos.overview: With an eye on payback, Do-gi transforms into a deep-pocketed customer to trick Kang Maria's tormentors. Kang Ha-na wonders about a missing criminal.

videos.title: A Victim of a School Violence
videos.overview: Do-gi goes undercover as a high school substitute teacher after receiving a call for help from a student who is being severely bullied.

videos.title: Teacher vs Students
videos.overview: The three bullies' attempts to mess with Do-gi come to a halt when they realize he possesses video footage that could ruin their lives.

videos.title: The Evil Businessman
videos.overview: While Ha-na looks into allegations of employees suffering physical abuse inside a powerful tech company, Do-gi poses as a new recruit there.

videos.title: Into the Strategic Planning Team
videos.overview: To gain access to Park Yang-jin's inner circle, Do-gi focuses his efforts on infiltrating a key department within the company.

videos.title: An Untimely Goodbye
videos.overview: As the truth behind an exploitative incident involving An Go-eun's sister comes to light, Do-gi sets out for revenge. Ha-na shows up with a warrant.

videos.title: The Vacation Home
videos.overview: Do-gi finds himself in danger after Yang-jin gives him a cruel test of loyalty. Go-eun returns to locate and destroy the data servers.

videos.title: The Voice Phishing Scam
videos.overview: Ha-na grows suspicious when she finds Do-gi's ID card at the scene of the explosion. Meanwhile, the team takes on a phone scam case.

videos.title: Mr. Wang and Madam Lim
videos.overview: Do-gi dons another disguise to lay his charms on the leader of the voice phishing operation. Ha-na keeps a close eye on the team's whereabouts.

videos.title: Tracking Down the Missing Murder Victim
videos.overview: Certain that Jang Seong-cheol and his employees are hiding something, Ha-na storms his home. A pastor worries about his missing son.

videos.title: A Colleague's Funeral
videos.overview: In mourning, Ha-na goes to Do-gi as a client in search of vengeance. While investigating, the team uncovers a larger scheme at play.

videos.title: A Prisoner Exchange
videos.overview: The team is taken by surprise when Baek Yeong-mi empties the secret prison cells. Do-gi plans to use Gu Yeong-tae as a bargaining chip.

videos.title: The Rainbow Transport Team In Danger
videos.overview: When Yeong-mi comes after the team, Do-gi throws himself into action to save them from her cruel clutches before it's too late.

videos.title: Rainbow Transport Decide to Disband
videos.overview: It's the end of the road for Seong-cheol and the team as they agree to shut down their operation. Do-gi is made to face the demons of his past.

videos.title: One Year Later
videos.overview: The team pulls together for one final mission to nail the true culprit behind the death of Do-gi's mother. Ha-na attempts to resign.

videos.title: The Missing Son
videos.overview: Despite the disbandment of Rainbow Taxi, Do-ki is still out there going after bad guys. While keeping it from the rest of the members, Do-ki and Sung-cheol secretly help out a father who is searching for his missing son. To confirm his whereabouts, Do-ki sets off abroad to a foreign country to accomplish his first mission.

videos.title: Back in Business
videos.overview: Do-ki successfully infiltrates Cheongeum with the help of his old crew. He pretends to be an abducted recruit but secretly searches for Dong-jae. During the search, he runs into Lim Bok-ja. He uses her revengeful anger to make it easier to find the missing boy. Just when he is about to capture the mastermind, a mysterious gun shot interrupts his arrest.

videos.title: The Trot Singer
videos.overview: An elderly woman visits Rainbow Transport as a victim. She owes a lot of money because of a young scammer who only rips money off old people. Do-ki and the team get infuriated upon seeing this and set up a plan to prevent this criminal from ever scamming the elderly again.

videos.title: Sang-gi’s Prison
videos.overview: Rainbow Transport officially begins its operation to bring punishment to Sang-gi. The plan mainly depends on Sung-cheol being a loaded old man as bait. As soon as Sang-gi sees this and plans to scam him, he does not realize the karma that he is about to face. Meanwhile, the secret organization Do-ki is after is also keeping an eye on Do-ki as well.

videos.title: Feel Consulting
videos.overview: Do-ki runs into a stray little girl on the street. Out of concern, he takes her to Rainbow Transport and learns that suspicious people are after her. Do-ki and the team tries to infiltrate Feel Consulting and get some info on Kang Pil-seung to find out why he is in search of this poor little girl.

videos.title: The Evil Uncle
videos.overview: Do-ki and Go-eun get busted by Pil-seung for putting up an act. However, Do-ki manages to win back his trust by acting how desperate he is for a house. Now that they are back on track, Do-ki learns how Pil-seung is able to help couples get housing by using children. Disgusted by his ways, the team is determined to bring down Pil-seung at all costs.

videos.title: The SunBaek Cult
videos.overview: The next client is a woman named Lee Jin-hee. Her beloved sister Jin-sun is suffering from a terminal disease and is relying on a cult to cure her. To save her from the cult and to take down its leader, Rainbow Transport begins service. However, Do-ki is not the one who will be infiltrating the cult this time.

videos.title: Beating a Cult with a Cult
videos.overview: The plan to destroy Ok Ju-man is now set. The only thing that remains is for Ju-man to take the bait. Although he does not have faith in any kind of religion, the Rainbow Transport team makes it seem believable. By setting the perfect scam, Ok Ju-man becomes faithful to the fake cult that Do-ki makes.

videos.title: The Surgery Malpractice
videos.overview: A smelly drunk man protests alone in front of a big hospital. He claims that his daughter is in a coma due to a surgery malpractice. Although Rainbow Transport took him in as a client, they are not sure whether this is an actual case or just an accident. Before they start anything, Do-ki looks into Ahn Young-sook, the director who performed the surgery.

videos.title: Jeil Chakhan Factory
videos.overview: Do-ki becomes a patient himself to infiltrate the operating room. When he is put to sleep, Go-eun finds out that there is a proxy who does the actual surgery while Young-sook goes somewhere else for a drink. Now that the team knows she is a complete fraud, they set up a meticulous plan to bring the witch down.

videos.title: The Late Kim Do-gi
videos.overview: Do-ki makes it out alive from the car bomb explosion. He uses his death to track down the person behind the vicious attack. While his funeral progresses, Do-ki and the team monitor any suspicious people coming and going, which leads them to a club for the rich in Gangnam. Do-ki makes his entrance to find out more.

videos.title: The Playground of Evil
videos.overview: After Do-ki gets kicked out from Black Sun and gets beaten up, the police arrive. However, the police arrest Do-ki instead. Although Yong-min helps him to bail out, Do-ki now knows that the police are working with Black Sun. Rainbow Transport infiltrates the club to take them down for all the crimes they are committing.

videos.title: Do-gi Crashes the Party
videos.overview: An angry VIP client at Black Sun puts the security team on edge. The security team gets a second chance to make another delivery. Only this time, Do-ki joins the team. What he learns is shocking. Meanwhile, Sung-cheol digs into Ha-joon's past.

videos.title: Ha-joon's Defeat
videos.overview: While Do-ki wakes up from getting drugged, the bishop comes back to Korea. Now that Do-ki has evidence of how Black Sun is circulating drugs, he sets up a plan. Meanwhile, Ha-joon notices that Rainbow Transport is on Black Sun’s tail. Knowing how skillful Do-ki is, he takes every precaution he can take.

videos.title: Ha-joon Versus Do-gi
videos.overview: Rainbow Transport takes in another client. However this time, it is a set-up made by the Bishop and Ha-joon. Not knowing that it is a trap, Do-ki blindly goes into Jangsan Correctional with Kyung-goo and Jin-eon to save a victim. The only thing that is waiting for him is Ha-joon's trap that will break Do-ki into pieces.

videos.title: The Final Client
videos.overview: Do-ki goes into Jangsan Correctional as an undercover inmate. He fights all the way through every trap that Ha-joon has prepared for him. Although he barely makes it in one piece, he saves Lee Si-wan. Meanwhile, Ha-joon learns about his true identity and what the Bishop has done to him since his childhood.

meta.slogan: For the wronged victims whom no one protects.
